title: trace
description: One shader invocation, stepped: the values it started with, every step the engine's debugger ran with the variables that changed on it, and the variable list it ended with. `stage` is what the engine says it debugged and `stageAsked` what the selector implies, so a disagreement is visible rather than assumed away. `outputs` is the running variable list at the last step, which is the invocation's own answer only when `truncated` is false.

event.description: the event the invocation ran at

stage.description: what the engine says it debugged

shader.description: the bound shader's resource id, digits only

stageAsked.description: the stage the selector implies: pixel=ps, vertex=vs, thread=cs, mesh-thread=ms

invocation.description: the invocation as it was asked for, e.g. `pixel 640,360` or `vertex 0,0,0,0`

sample.description: --sample, only when it was given: `DebugPixelInputs`' field, whose default means `no preference`

debuggable.description: the engine's verdict on this shader (ShaderDebugInfo), when it published a reflection

sourceDebugInfo.description: whether the shader's debug data was found: a DXIL shader is stepped *through* it, so false on one of those means no trace at all, while a DXBC shader steps from its bytecode either way

debugStatus.description: the engine's own sentence, only when it gave one

constantBlocks.description: how many constant blocks the trace carries (their values are `cb`'s answer, read through the reflection's names)

resources.description: read-only plus read-write resource variables the trace carries

sourceVariables.description: source-level variable mappings the trace carries: non-zero only with debug info

inputs.description: `name = value`, the values the invocation started with

instruction.description: the next instruction after this state: the engine's own program counter

events.description: the ShaderEvents flags on this step: none, sample/load/gather, nan/inf, debugbreak, or an unknown bit as hex

source.description: file:line[-line] covering this instruction from the trace's instInfo, empty without debug info or when no mapping covers it

changes.description: `name: before -> after`, `name = value (new)` for a variable that came into scope, `name left scope` for one that stopped existing

outputs.description: `name = value` after the last step: the variables the invocation changed, accumulated the way RenderDoc's own UI accumulates a debug state

stepCount.description: rows in `steps`: less than the invocation's length only when `truncated`

truncated.description: true when --max-steps (or the hard cap under --all) stopped the run before the invocation finished, so `outputs` is the state at the cap rather than the invocation's end
